sentences.text: Dangerous Beauty is a 1998 American biographical drama film directed by Marshall Herskovitz and starring Catherine McCormack , Rufus Sewell , and Oliver Platt .	Marshall Herskovitz	Marshall Herskovitz	Catherine McCormack	Catherine McCormack	Rufus Sewell	Rufus Sewell	Oliver Platt	Oliver Platt	biographical	biographical film	drama film	drama film

Based on the non-fiction book The Honest Courtesan by Margaret Rosenthal , the film is about Veronica Franco , a courtesan in sixteenth-century Venice who becomes a hero to her city , but later becomes the target of an inquisition by the Church for witchcraft .
